channel.title: NEXUS Notifications
channel.description: Site updates, feature announcements, and important alerts for NEXUS users

item.title: 🔧 Zunime Anime & VidSrc Scraper Restored in Production!
item.description:
We have deployed critical stability and routing fixes for Zunime and VidSrc:
• VidSrc Stability Fix: Deployed robust Playwright browser recovery to the VidSrc VPS to instantly restart if the headless browser crashes during extraction, solving silent failures. • VidSrc Port Fix: Adjusted Vercel's production routing to proxy VidSrc to port 4001, matching the actual live backend. • Zunime API Fix: Added missing Vercel rewrite rules for /nexus-zunime and /nexus-anilist. The production app can now successfully proxy requests to Zunime's Anime sources and the AniList GraphQL API!
Please reload the page (or clear cache) to enjoy stable streaming for both movies and anime on NEXUS!

item.title: 🔧 MovieBox & VidSrc Proxy Routing Fixed!
item.description:
Critical fixes deployed to restore streaming sources:
• Fixed "invalid source id" crash: graceful fallback when embed IDs are not in metadata cache — no more fatal crashes on movie pages. • Fixed MovieBox & VidSrc proxy: Vercel now correctly routes /moviebox-api/* → VPS:8000 and /nexus-vidsrc/* → VPS:4000 instead of serving index.html. • Fixed TMDB proxy in production: /nexus-tmdb/* now proxies directly to api.themoviedb.org via Vercel rewrites. • Fixed checkIsAnime in production: no longer calls the broken dev proxy path.
MovieBox 🔥 and VidSrc 🔗 should now work. Reload the page to get the update!

item.title: XML Notifications & Metadata Null-Safety Deployed!
item.description:
We have deployed stability and UI fixes across NEXUS:
• XML Feed Repair: Fixed missing XML item tags in `notifications.xml` resolving browser XML parsing errors. • Metadata Safeguards: Added safe optional chaining for show metadata to ensure smooth episode loading. • Clean Linting & Build: Resolved ESLint button type checks and verified 100% clean production build (`pnpm run build`).
Enjoy streaming on NEXUS!

item.title: Instant Metadata Loading & Anime Show Performance Fix!
item.description:
We have deployed a major performance optimization for metadata loading:
• Instant TMDB Metadata: Optimized TV series metadata loading for long-running shows (One Piece, Simpsons, Pokemon) by eliminating 20+ redundant season requests on page load! • Network Timeout Resilience: Increased TMDB API timeout threshold to prevent network aborts. • 100% Clean Build: Fixed all linting and TypeScript checks.
Enjoy seamless streaming on NEXUS!

item.title: Zunime Anime Provider & Multi-Audio Dubs Fully Fixed!
item.description:
We have resolved provider scraping issues and restored audio dubs:
• Zunime Anime Fix: Resolved the `invalid source id` issue by registering Zunime embed scrapers globally in the provider registry. • Multi-Audio Dub Restoration: Fixed audio track state syncing so MovieBox multi-audio dubs (Tagalog, Hindi, Spanish, etc.) now appear and switch seamlessly in the player Audio menu! • ESLint & Clean Build: Fixed button type lint warning and verified clean production build (`pnpm run build`).
Enjoy watching on NEXUS!

item.title: Automatic Subtitles & System Improvements Deployed!
item.description:
We have implemented system fixes and subtitle improvements:
• Auto-Default Subtitles: The player now automatically selects and displays English subtitles by default without requiring manual configuration when they are available! • External Subtitle Sources Restored: Added robust integrations for fetching external subtitle sources. • Build Fixes: Addressed background issues to ensure maximum reliability and a faster streaming experience.
Enjoy your seamless streaming experience on NEXUS!

item.title: Provider Architecture Streamlined & Unified in One Place!
item.description:
We have updated and unified our streaming provider architecture:
• Unified Provider List: Combined MovieBox with all official built-in P-Stream sources so all working providers display seamlessly in one single area. • Deprecated Sources Cleaned Up: Removed vidlink, videasy, vidfast, hexa, and yflix sources to focus purely on MovieBox and official built-in providers.
Enjoy high-speed streaming on NEXUS!

item.title: TMDB Provider Removed & Streamlined Provider Pipeline
item.description:
We have updated the streaming provider pipeline:
• Removed TMDB / NEXUS Embed Provider: Completely removed `tmdbProvider` (`nexus-tmdb`) and its health probes. • MovieBox & Built-In Providers: Maintained `MovieBox` VPS as our primary multi-audio provider alongside our default built-in sources.
Enjoy streaming on NEXUS!

item.title: Full Project Audit, Codebase Cleanliness & Build Verification Complete!
item.description:
We have performed a full project review, codebase cleanup, and build verification:
• Full Architecture Audit: Verified custom providers, MovieBox multi-audio dub strategies, and provider health checks. • Clean Production Build: Fixed all lint warnings and verified 100% clean production build (`pnpm run build`). • Complete Rebrand Alignment: Verified zero legacy P-Stream/Z-Stream branding across code, PWA manifest, and HTML templates.
Thank you for using NEXUS!

item.title: EMBED-API Docker Container Verified Across All 14 Endpoints!
item.description:
We have successfully deployed and verified the EMBED-API streaming backend inside Docker:
• 100% Endpoint Pass Rate: Verified all 14 REST and auth endpoints against our running Docker container with zero errors. • High-Speed Stream Aggregation: Verified returning 37 HD streams for movies and 73 HD streams for TV series across multiple audio dubs and subtitles directly from our Docker image. • Universal Route & Query Compatibility: Patched `apiServer.js` to support `:type = 'tv'` alongside `'movie'` and `'series'`, plus `?s=`/`?e=` query parameter fallbacks for seamless client integration.
Thank you for being part of the NEXUS community!

item.title: EMBED-API & MovieBox Engine Overhaul Deployed!
item.description:
We have deployed a massive backend streaming upgrade to power your NEXUS experience:
• MovieBox JWT Token Bridge: Resolved token expiration issues and optimized movie indexing, unlocking 13+ high-speed streams for movies and 40+ streams for TV series across multiple audio dubs and subtitles. • Strict Anime Isolation: Separated regular Movie & TV series lookups from Anime sources (`anikoto`, `anikai`, etc.), ensuring lightning-fast search latency without interference. • Ultra-Fast Alternative Sources: Added clean embed providers (`vsembed.ru` and `vidsrcme.ru`) while disabling slow legacy scrapers for instant video playback. • Custom Admin Portal: Modernized the backend login box with real-time status and rate-limit lockouts.
Join our Discord for support or to share feedback!

item.title: Congratulations! NEXUS Reaches 88% Completion!
item.description:
We are thrilled to announce that the new NEXUS streaming platform has officially reached 88% completion after an incredible few days of rapid development!
Our architecture is stronger, faster, and more secure than ever before. We are fine-tuning the remaining components as we prepare for our grand public launch. Thank you for being part of our community!
JOIN OUR DISCORD SERVER for live progress updates, early previews, and support! Link below.

item.title: Major Platform Updates: MovieBox, Dual-Auth & UI Overhaul
item.description:
We have deployed major updates and improvements across the NEXUS ecosystem:
• MovieBox Streaming Provider: Restored and fully optimized as our primary high-speed source with robust HLS multi-server video delivery. • Sleek Frosted-Glass Login Box: Upgraded to a custom Netflix-inspired frosted overlay featuring real-time password strength bars and clean dual-auth switching. • Multi-Device Passkey & Roaming: Enabled cross-device WebAuthn passkey registration, allowing you to save and sync credentials across mobile phones, hardware keys, and password managers (1Password / Bitwarden). • Global UI Alignment: Polished top header controls, integrated instant passkey generation right inside Account Settings, and set responsive detail overlays as the global default.
Join our Discord or reach out on Facebook for questions or feedback!
